notes: Matrix had 8 acceptance criteria; produced 11 artifacts (4 backend test functions in one new file covering the API-bearing parts of criteria 1-5, 7 browser checks covering all 8 UI-facing criteria -- criteria 2 and 3 share one combined browser check since they are a single continuous flow: unlock -> storage/cookie checks -> reload persistence -> percentile change -> reuse rejection).

Discovered and worked around an httpx-specific quirk (not an app bug): the ds_unlocks and ds_admin cookies are Secure, so plain-HTTP httpx test clients never auto-resend them (browsers accept Secure cookies on https:// and on localhost, which is what the browser checks exercise per spec_deviations). The new backend test extracts the Set-Cookie token from the response and sends it back explicitly as a Cookie header instead of relying on the httpx cookie jar.

Backend rate-limiting on unlocks (max 5 per email per 24h) was hit during iteration while reusing delivered@resend.dev across repeated manual runs; browser checks now generate a unique @example.com email per run to stay rerun-safe, and only the dedicated PDF-receipt-email criterion (not in this matrix) would need delivered@resend.dev specifically.

Cleaned up all test fixtures per seed_facts: deleted 7 predictor_unlocks docs (payment_id starting pay_TESTAGENT) and 7 leads (name starting 'Test Agent') created during this run; no tscheck-prefixed exam record was persisted (the FAQ editor check never submits the form).
